temperament.jaymoskingdoms.yours: Your nature is set for good: %s
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.h: Helps anyone up, anywhere, whatever you've done. Won't strike someone who's down.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.hove: Forgives a poor name, helps out in the wild too, and quickly.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.devout.hover: Mercy is a duty: helps anyone who isn't the land's enemy. Won't strike someone who's down.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.hover: Helps whoever their people think well of.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.brave.hover: Helps whoever their people think well of, monsters or not. Stands their ground.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.proud.hover: Helps only those of real standing. Can't be bought off.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.hover: Helps anyone not an enemy who can pay, and takes a fee. Takes anyone's bribe.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.ho: Won't help a stranger: introduce yourself first.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.timid.hover: Helps only with no monster near. Frightened easily, runs from fights.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.hov: Never helps someone they're cross with. Quick to fight, even someone feared.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.hove: Helps only a friend, and laughs at everyone else's misfortune.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.hover: Helps whoever their people think well of, from nearby only, and slowly.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.h: Hold on, hold on! I've got you.
Easy now, whoever you are. Let's get you up.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.help: Up you get! It's not so bad as all that.
Had a tumble? Here, I'll patch you up.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.devout.help.0: Mercy for all. Lie still and I'll tend you.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.devout.help.1: No one is left to die where I can help it.
Stay down, I'll see to you.
One of ours is hurt! Coming.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.brave.help.0: Never mind them, I'm getting you out of this.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.brave.help.1: Grit your teeth, friend. I'm here.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.proud.help.0: You're worth the trouble. Barely. Hold still.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.proud.help.1: Someone of your name shouldn't be lying in the dirt.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.help.0: Looks like you need help. Help costs, mind.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.help.1: I'll get you up. We'll talk about payment after.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.he: I know you, at least. Don't make me regret this.
Fine. But I'm watching your hands.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.timid.help.0: Is it safe? Oh... all right, quickly.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.timid.help.1: Please don't let anything come back. Hold still.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.hel: Who did this to you? I'll break their nose. Up!
Get up and let's find them!
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.help: Only because it's you. Don't tell anyone.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.help.0: Of course this happens. Hold still.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.help.1: We all end up on the ground sooner or later...
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.jeer: Ha! Look at you down there.
Serves you right. Don't expect any help from me.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.fee.1: %s for my trouble. Cheap at the price.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.command.nobod: No one with a temperament nearby.
